literal: If one is without good qualities, has many faults, and becomes without allies, it possesses great security for his enemies.
translation: If a person has no good qualities, possesses many faults, and lacks any allies, he becomes an easy target, offering a great advantage and security to his enemies.
modern: ஒருவன் நற்குணங்கள் இல்லாதவனாய், பல குற்றங்களை உடையவனாய், துணையாக இருக்கும் சுற்றத்தாரும் இல்லாதவனாய் இருந்தால், அது அவனுடைய பகைவர்களுக்குப் பெரும் பாதுகாப்பாக அமைந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the traits that make an opponent extremely vulnerable and easy to conquer. When a person lacks virtuous qualities and is burdened with numerous flaws, they naturally fail to win the trust of others. Consequently, they end up completely isolated without any allies or supporters to defend them. This state of utter weakness and friendlessness provides a great sense of security and an effortless victory to their enemies.
